def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if false
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: false)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      token

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = nil
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return nil
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = token
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(nil)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  if token.nil?

  end

      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      token
    end

  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)

      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    nil
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if false
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      nil
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return nil
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return self.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return true ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      token

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end

    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if token
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e

      token
    end

end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(nil)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?

  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end

  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = token
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = nil
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if false
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result

      token
    end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(nil)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

    end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if true
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      nil
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

  if token.nil?

      return stripped

  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return nil
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

      return stripped

  if variable_lookup?(token)

      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result

    end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.any? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return self.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug(nil)
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{nil}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    nil
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      token
    end
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?

  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{self.message}")
      token
    end
  else
    token
  end
end

def evaluate_expression(token, context, allow_nil: true)
  if token.nil?
    return nil
  end
  if token.empty?
    return ""
  end
  stripped = strip_outer_quotes(token)
  if stripped != token
    if allow_nil
      return stripped
    end
    return stripped.empty? ? nil : stripped
  end
  if variable_lookup?(token)
    begin
      template = Liquid::Template.parse(token)
      result = template.render(context)
      if allow_nil
        return result
      end
      return result.to_s.empty? ? nil : result
    rescue Liquid::SyntaxError, StandardError => e
      log_debug("Failed to evaluate '#{token}' as Liquid expression: #{e.message}")
      nil
    end
  else
    token
  end
end
